verdict.rationale: The only sign of API versioning is the Product Feed API's versioned path (POST/DELETE /v1/ingestions), and Adyen publishes OpenAPI specs it calls the single source of truth for its APIs. Nothing in the pack documents a versioning scheme or any deprecation or sunset policy. Missing for 10: a documented API versioning scheme across Checkout/Management APIs, a published deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.
